recommendations.text: Monitor pest activity, particularly fall armyworm and cutworm, which have been reported as high severity. Ensure the irrigation system is functioning properly and consider adjusting the irrigation schedule if necessary. Continue to monitor market prices and consider selling sorghum when prices are favorable.
